title: It's on your LEFT. Do you still wait? 🔄 #shorts
description:
You're entering a roundabout. A car already going round is coming from your left. Who goes first?
Comment A, B, C or D 👇

#roadrules #roundabout #driving #drivingtest #quiz #noggin #shorts

scenes.question: Who goes first?
options: You, the car is on your left
The car, it's on the roundabout
scenes.why: Entering a roundabout, you give way to cars already on it. The right-hand rule doesn't apply here.

different: They drive on the left, so you give way to cars coming from your right.
At a few old ones with no sign, like the Arc de Triomphe, cars entering go first.
